Make the totality explicit: show 'סה"כ לתשלום כולל משלוח' in the cart drawer before checkout, and one line 'המחיר כולל מע"מ · אין עלויות נוספות' near the PDP price. When Grow goes live, list the payment methods on the PDP so nobody reaches checkout unsure whether Bit/PayPal/installments exist (9% abandon for insufficient payment methods).

findings.principle: Real product photography — on a human body and in scale; users ignore decorative/stock imagery and scrutinize real product photos (Baymard 2017/2020; NN/g 2010)
findings.what: Baymard product-page testing: 56% of test subjects' first action on a new product page was exploring the images; 42% try to gauge size from images; 28% of sites offer no 'in scale' image (article 30 May 2017). Baymard 'human model' (1 Dec 2020): for items worn on the body users need a model shot to judge size, length and how it sits — participants explicitly hunted for 'a picture… if anyone is wearing it'. NN/g eyetracking (2010): product photos are scrutinized (12 fixations on one close-up), purely decorative and stock-model images are skipped.
findings.source: https://baymard.com/blog/in-scale-product-images ; https://baymard.com/blog/human-model ; https://www.nngroup.com/articles/photos-as-web-content/
findings.honestApplication: Two SKUs (chishuk, tzel-knafayim) still have only a white-background cutout (CLAUDE.md) — shoot them on a real neck/wrist before spending on ads for them. For every SKU show: worn-on-body, a scale reference (coin/hand), the actual padded box and the blessing card as they arrive (the gift buyer is buying the unboxing moment for someone else), and a real microscope frame of a real chip. No AI-generated wearers presented as customers; if a model is used, it is a model, not 'a customer'.

findings.principle: Operational transparency / the 'labor illusion' — showing the work being done raises perceived value and triggers reciprocity (Buell & Norton 2011)
findings.what: Five experiments (Management Science 57(9), 2011, pp. 1564–1579): when a site visibly signals the effort it is exerting, people value the result more — even preferring a slower service with visible work over an instant identical result; perceived effort induces feelings of reciprocity. NN/g 2016 usability studies likewise found users wanted process photos, 'not just end results'.
findings.source: https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/mnsc.1110.1376 ; https://www.nngroup.com/articles/trustworthy-design/
findings.honestApplication: The store's real process (slice prep → FIB engraving → character-by-character verification → hand setting under a sapphire window, serial number and certificate) is already written in Process.tsx and /craft, but the PDP purchase box does not show it. Add a compact 'מה קורה אחרי ההזמנה' strip on the PDP with the verification step, and — if the lab can supply it — a real photo of the microscope comparison for one chip. The 'מספר סידורי ותעודה' line appears only on the home page; if every item truly ships with a serial number and certificate, put it in the PDP spec table (that is a verifiable, physical proof the buyer will hold). Only real images and only steps that happen for every order.

findings.principle: Precision as a confidence cue — exact numbers are read as more confident and more credible than round ones (Jerez-Fernandez, Angulo & Oppenheimer 2014)
findings.what: Psychological Science 25(2), 2014, pp. 633–635: people judge speakers who use precise numbers as more confident than those using round numbers, and prefer them as advisors. (Related: Loschelder et al. 2016 show a 'too-much-precision' effect exists at extreme precision.)
findings.source: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24317423/
findings.honestApplication: The site already leans on exact figures (Hero: 'עד N תווים' derived from lib/blessings.ts; ₪29; 2–4 business days; 12/2 months). The rule here is the owner's rule: precision only where a source exists. That cuts both ways — keep the character count (computed), the policy numbers (policy.ts) and the registration number; remove or measure the unsourced '9 micron' and the three mutually contradictory size figures in Hero/craft SPECS/faq.ts, because a precise number that a buyer can catch being wrong reverses the effect (see finding #1).

findings.principle: Interactive, human presence (instant messaging) builds swift trust with an unknown seller — and in Israel that channel is WhatsApp (Ou, Pavlou & Davison 2014)
findings.what: MIS Quarterly 38(1), 2014, pp. 209–230, longitudinal data from 338 buyers: instant messaging and feedback tools build 'swift guanxi' and trust through interactivity and social presence, increasing repeat transactions with a seller. The Israel Internet Association's 2025 annual report (as reported by The Jerusalem Post, 26 Oct 2025) puts WhatsApp use at 99% of the Israeli population.
findings.source: https://misq.umn.edu/swift-guanxi-in-online-marketplaces-the-role-of-computer-mediated-communication-technologies.html ; https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-871715
findings.honestApplication: WhatsAppFab.tsx exists. Make the presence human and specific: pre-filled first message that names the product page it came from; a signed greeting with the founder's real first name; published response hours (and a measured typical response time only after it has actually been logged for a few weeks — not 'תוך דקות' by assumption). Add a 'לא בטוחים איזה נוסח מתאים? כתבו לנו' link next to the blessing selector on the PDP — the gift buyer's real hesitation is choosing the wrong blessing for someone else, and a human answer resolves it without any review.

findings.principle: Hierarchy of trust — do not ask for personal data before baseline trust exists; modal popups are the most-hated pattern on both desktop and mobile (NN/g 2016, 2017)
findings.what: NN/g Sherwin 2016: five commitment levels (relevance/credibility → preference → personal info → financial info → ongoing relationship); 'don't make demands at higher levels of commitment until you've addressed all the trust needs at the inferior levels'; sites that ask for email/address on arrival cause abandonment. NN/g 2017 survey (452 US adults rating 23 ad formats): modal/pop-up/lightbox ads were the #1 most disliked on desktop and mobile. Stanford guideline #9: avoid pop-ups.
findings.source: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/commitment-levels/ ; https://www.nngroup.com/articles/most-hated-advertising-techniques/ ; https://credibility.stanford.edu/guidelines
findings.honestApplication: SignupPopup.tsx opens once per visitor after 18 s or 35% scroll and asks for name + phone + email — a level-3 ask from a brand the visitor met 18 seconds ago. The 20% first-order code is real and can stay; move the ask down the hierarchy: show it as an inline non-modal block on the PDP under the price or in the cart drawer ('20% על ההזמנה הראשונה למצטרפים'), or trigger only after add-to-cart. Ask for the minimum needed to deliver the code (email only, as the footer already does). Measure: the popup's lead rate vs. the resulting purchase rate is in GA4 (trackLead) — if leads don't convert, the popup is paying in trust for nothing.

findings.principle: Deceptive urgency (countdown timers that reset, fake scarcity) is detected, judged manipulative, and can cancel the pull of a real discount (Tiemessen et al., CHI 2023)
findings.what: Online experiment, N=245 EU shoppers, conditions: no offer / discount only / discount + deceptive resetting countdown timer. Deceptive timers affected product choice like discounts did, but induced responses from indifference to participants deeming them 'manipulative, deceptive, and feel negatively impacted'; the timer 'can diminish the incentive of consumers to choose a product with a discount', making some consumers avoid sites with timers; discount-only was qualitatively more successful. NN/g 2016: company-sponsored testimonials are trusted less than third-party sources; an isolated or padded site 'appears to either have something to hide or not be a fully established, stable company'. Baymard's DIY-seal finding shows fake badges can 'work' short-term — which is why they are a trap for a brand whose whole pitch is textual accuracy.
findings.source: 'The Time is Ticking', CHI EA 2023 — https://dl.acm.org/doi/full/10.1145/3544549.3585735 (thesis PDF: https://www.cs.ru.nl/masters-theses/2022/J_Tiemessen___The_time_is_ticking:_the_effect_of_deceptive_countdown_timers_on_consumers'_buying_behavior_and_experience.pdf) ; https://www.nngroup.com/articles/trustworthy-design/
findings.honestApplication: Confirms the owner's hard rules are also the conversion-optimal choice for this store. Keep the '20% הנחה על ההזמנה הראשונה' as a plain, permanent, code-based offer with no timer. The only honest urgency available is calendar urgency the buyer already feels: the delivery-date window plus a factual 'להגעה עד [חג/תאריך] יש להזמין עד [date]' computed from POLICY days and the real holiday calendar — a derived number, not a countdown. Never show 'X people viewing', 'only N left' (stock is not tracked per SKU as scarcity), or struck-through 'was' prices.

findings.principle: Design quality, zero errors, no dead links — first impressions are dominated by 'design look', and a single typo or broken link reads as carelessness (Fogg 2003; Stanford #6/#10; NN/g)
findings.what: Fogg et al. 2003 (2,684 participants): 'design look' was the most frequent basis for credibility judgments (46.1% of comments). Stanford guideline #10: eliminate typographical errors and broken links, keep the site up. NN/g 2016: one participant dropped a mover for a spelling error; Baymard: 17% abandoned because the site had errors or crashed.
findings.source: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/997078.997097 ; https://credibility.stanford.edu/guidelines ; https://www.nngroup.com/articles/trustworthy-design/ ; https://baymard.com/lists/cart-abandonment-rate
findings.honestApplication: The team already removed the '#' social links, the template-y gradients/counters and watermark (CLAUDE.md list of 'נראה מיוצר'). Remaining trust-relevant defects to close: verify the sticky buy bar on a real phone (if broken there is no CTA after scrolling); run a link/typo pass on the 15 PDPs and 8 gift guides; keep the three 'pending' test orders out of any visible order counter (there is none — keep it that way). No new visual 'trust' decoration; the hairline, Heebo, letter-numbered lists are the credibility.

findings.principle: Policies must be findable where users expect them — the footer — with direct 'shipping' and 'returns' links (Baymard 2019/2025); plus outward links to authoritative sources (NN/g factor 4)
findings.what: Baymard: 20% of sites lack direct footer links to return policy and shipping info; test participants went straight to the footer ('I go to the bottom because that's where it usually has all those things') and were frustrated into 'information hunting' through generic Help/FAQ links when the keywords were missing. NN/g factor 4: linking outward to third-party sources signals openness; an isolated site looks like it has something to hide.
findings.source: https://baymard.com/blog/footer-needs-return-shipping-links ; https://www.nngroup.com/articles/communicating-trustworthiness/
findings.honestApplication: Footer.tsx already links תנאי שימוש / פרטיות / נגישות / משלוחים והחזרות — met. Two honest additions: (1) since the store has no social accounts, the outward links that are available are the scripture sources — link each blessing's chapter/verse in lib/blessings.ts to a public canonical text so a buyer can verify the wording off-site; (2) when a real Instagram/TikTok account exists, add exactly one live link (the CLAUDE.md rule), never a placeholder. Do not add a 'לקוחות מספרים' or ratings block until there are real reviews collected through a verifiable channel — NN/g's data says site-hosted testimonials are the least trusted form anyway.

findings.principle: Giver–recipient price asymmetry (price does not buy appreciation)
findings.what: Flynn & Adams (2009), three studies: gift-givers expected a positive correlation between what they spent and how much the recipient would appreciate the gift (because they assume a higher price signals more thoughtfulness), while gift-recipients reported no association between price and their appreciation. Journal of Experimental Social Psychology 45(2), 404–409.
findings.source: Francis J. Flynn & Gabrielle S. Adams, Stanford GSB — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0022103108002175
findings.honestApplication: Do not build any 'spend more = they'll love it more' upsell (no 'premium' badges, no nudging from ₪279 to ₪749). The honest lever is the opposite: tell the hesitant giver that the thing that carries the meaning is identical at every price. This is derivable from the code — CHIP_SPEC in lib/catalog.ts is shared by all 15 models and lib/faq.ts already says 'הבחירה אינה משנה את המחיר'. Add one factual line under the price in components/ProductView.tsx: 'השבב והנוסח זהים בכל הדגמים, מ-₪279 ועד ₪749 – ההבדל הוא במתכת ובעיצוב בלבד'. It removes the 'is ₪279 too cheap for a gift?' doubt without any invented claim.

findings.principle: Explicitness: recipients prefer gifts they asked for; givers overrate unsolicited gifts
findings.what: Gino & Flynn (2011), five studies: recipients were more appreciative of gifts they explicitly requested than unrequested ones, but givers assumed both would be equally appreciated and expected unsolicited gifts to be seen as more thoughtful than they actually were. Givers were more willing to buy the requested item when the recipient named one specific gift rather than a list. JESP 47(5), 915–922.
findings.source: Francesca Gino (Harvard) & Francis Flynn (Stanford) — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0022103111000801 (Stanford GSB summary: https://www.gsb.stanford.edu/faculty-research/publications/give-them-what-they-want-benefits-explicitness-gift-exchange)
findings.honestApplication: Let the recipient into the choice without pretending. Two honest options: (1) a 'לשאול אותו/אותה איזה נוסח' share button next to the blessing chooser in ProductView.tsx that opens WhatsApp (wa.me is already wired via lib/company.ts) with the /blessings link — the giver asks, the recipient names one blessing, the giver buys with certainty; (2) surface the existing FAQ fact 'אפשר להחליף את הברכה כל עוד ההזמנה לא נשלחה' as a single line directly under the chooser, so a giver who guesses knows the guess is reversible. A gift card (which Pandora IL, Danon, Shani Jacobi and Mejuri all sell) is the fullest form of this lever but requires WooCommerce gift-card setup first — do not show it until it exists.

findings.principle: Feasibility beats desirability for recipients (construal level)
findings.what: Baskin, Wakslak, Trope & Novemsky (2014): givers construe gifts abstractly and weight desirability, while receivers weight feasibility/practicality; givers therefore do not choose the gift that maximises receiver happiness even though they believe they do. Journal of Consumer Research 41(1), 169–182.
findings.source: Ernest Baskin, Cheryl Wakslak, Yaacov Trope, Nathan Novemsky — https://academic.oup.com/jcr/article-abstract/41/1/169/1810280
findings.honestApplication: Answer the feasibility questions the giver forgets to ask, near the buy button rather than inside the collapsed spec accordion: chain length and the 5 cm extension (already in catalog specs), 'חישוק' fits almost any wrist (already in guides.data.ts), steel 316L for sensitive skin, 'נעלם מתחת לחולצה', shower/sea guidance from CARE_SPEC. These are all true product facts already in lib/catalog.ts; the change is placement — a 3-line 'יתאים לו/לה?' block in ProductView.tsx above the description. No sizes = no size risk is a real advantage worth one sentence on necklace/bracelet pages.

findings.principle: Sentimental gifts: givers avoid them out of fear, recipients prefer them
findings.what: Givi & Galak (2017), three studies: when choosing between a sentimentally valuable gift and a preference-matching gift, givers pick the preference-matching one more often than recipients would like, because givers feel certain the safe gift will be liked but uncertain about the sentimental one ('home runs or strikeouts' vs 'a sure single'). Participants primed by writing about risks that succeeded were much more likely to choose the sentimental gift. Journal of Consumer Psychology 27(4), 473–479.
findings.source: Julian Givi & Jeff Galak (Carnegie Mellon) — https://myscp.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1016/j.jcps.2017.06.002 ; ScienceDaily summary https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2017/07/170725100701.htm
findings.honestApplication: A nano-engraved blessing is exactly the 'sentimental' option this research says givers wrongly shy away from. The mechanism is uncertainty, so the lever is to shrink the perceived downside, truthfully: the blessing is changeable until dispatch, the item is returnable for 30 days (lib/policy.ts), and — unlike Pandora IL and Mejuri, whose policies exclude engraved items — mikra's closed-list engraving keeps the legal cancellation right (lib/faq.ts already states this). Put these three facts in one 'אם זה לא זה' line under the CTA in ProductView.tsx and in each guide's closing. Do not add 'they will love it' claims or testimonials.

findings.principle: Smile-seeking: givers optimise for the reveal moment, less so when not giving in person
findings.what: Yang & Urminsky (2018), six studies: givers forgo satisfaction-maximising gifts in favour of reaction-maximising ones because they anticipate the recipient's immediate affective reaction; this preference was mitigated when givers anticipated not giving the gift in person. Psychological Science 29(8), 1221–1233.
findings.source: Adelle X. Yang (NUS) & Oleg Urminsky (Chicago Booth) — https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/0956797618761373
findings.honestApplication: For in-person gifting the reveal is the open box: show it. There is currently no photograph of the real box, card or fabric-wrapped ₪49 upgrade anywhere in public/ (only hero, products, scene, worn), and BOX_SPEC in lib/catalog.ts is text-only inside a closed accordion. Photograph the actual box contents and put the image next to the gift-box toggle in ProductView.tsx. For ship-to-recipient orders the giver is absent from the reveal, so the substitute is a written message (see gifting-flow finding). Both are real assets, not claims.

findings.principle: The thought counts only when it is made visible; gifts that reflect the giver build closeness
findings.what: Zhang & Epley (2012), four experiments: a giver's thoughtfulness raised the recipient's appreciation only when something triggered the recipient to consider it (e.g. a bad gift from a friend); givers mispredict this, and the thought mainly 'counts' for the giver by increasing their felt connection. Aknin & Human (2015), six experiments: gifts that reflect the giver's own tastes and values (an act of self-disclosure) produced stronger giver–receiver closeness than recipient-centric gifts, contrary to what most surveyed people said they prefer to give.
findings.source: Yan Zhang & Nicholas Epley, J. Exp. Psychol.: General 141(4) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22774790/ ; Lara Aknin & Lauren Human, JESP 60, 8–16 — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0022103115000372
findings.honestApplication: The card in the box (name of the blessing, sources, full text — components/home/Assurance.tsx) already makes the thought visible. What is missing is the giver's own line. Add a 'הקדשה למקבל/ת' textarea to app/checkout/CheckoutForm.tsx, shown when 'זו מתנה' or the gift box is selected: the API already accepts a `note` of up to 500 chars (app/api/checkout/route.ts lines 24, 91) and stores it as WooCommerce customer_note (lib/wcOrderCore.ts line 170) — the form simply never sends it. Print it on the existing card; state 'מודפסת בדיוק כפי שנכתבה' (Mejuri's wording) only once the print step exists.

findings.principle: Gift anxiety = high motivation × pessimism about success (Wooten)
findings.what: Wooten (2000), 135 participants (115 critical-incident surveys + 20 interviews): givers become anxious when highly motivated to elicit a desired reaction but pessimistic about their chances; determinants sit in the recipient (e.g. hard to please, has everything), the giver, and the situation. Journal of Consumer Research 27(1), 84–95.
findings.source: David B. Wooten — https://academic.oup.com/jcr/article-abstract/27/1/84/1791561
findings.honestApplication: The homepage Closing.tsx already targets the classic anxious case ('מה נותנים למי שיש לו הכול?'). Reduce pessimism with concrete answers to the four 'what ifs' rather than reassurance adjectives: wrong blessing → change before dispatch; doesn't suit → 30-day exchange; recipient won't understand it → card carries the full text; too late → the date window from components/DeliveryEstimate.tsx. Every one of these is already true on the site; group them once, in the 8 gift guides (lib/guides.data.ts) and in the FAQ head. No countdowns, no 'only X left'.

findings.principle: Return-policy leniency raises purchases more than it raises returns; time and exchange leniency reduce returns
findings.what: Janakiraman, Syrdal & Freling (2016) meta-analysis of 22 papers across five leniency dimensions (time, money, effort, scope, exchange): leniency's effect on purchase is larger than on returns; money and effort leniency increase purchases; time and exchange leniency reduce returns. Journal of Retailing 92(2), 226–235.
findings.source: Narayan Janakiraman (UT Arlington), Holly Syrdal, Ryan Freling — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0022435915000822 ; ScienceDaily https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2016/06/160620140944.htm
findings.honestApplication: mikra is already time-lenient (30 days vs Pandora IL 14 days, Danon 14 business days for site orders). The gaps are effort and scope for the person who actually holds the gift: lib/legal.ts requires returns 'בצירוף חשבונית' and the recipient of a ship-to-recipient order has no invoice. Honest fix: include a price-less 'פתק החלפה' in every box (Danon: 'פתק החלפה מצורף לכל הזמנה'; Pandora IL accepts 'חשבונית/פתק החלפה'), count the 30 days from the recipient's delivery date, and say so in lib/faq.ts and on the PDP. Only promise this after the owner decides to print the slip; the 5% legal cancellation fee can stay for cancellations while exchanges are free.

findings.principle: Delivery date, not shipping speed — a promise, not a calculation
findings.what: Baymard: 41% of benchmarked sites didn't provide a delivery date, forcing test participants to stop and calculate (one opened her desktop calendar); users treat a stated date as a promise by the brand; Baymard calls this 'particularly important for sites with a high proportion of gift orders' and recommends the date alongside each option in checkout and on the product page.
findings.source: Baymard Institute — https://baymard.com/blog/shipping-speed-vs-delivery-date
findings.honestApplication: components/DeliveryEstimate.tsx already computes a real date window on the PDP ('מגיע אליכם 18-22 בספטמבר'), but app/checkout/CheckoutForm.tsx shows only the SHIPPING note '2-4 ימי עסקים' from lib/policy.ts. Reuse the same addBusinessDays logic to print the date window inside the delivery radio in checkout, and keep pickup as 'בתיאום בוואטסאפ'. A dispatch cut-off line ('הזמנה עד 14:00 יוצאת היום') is honest only if the owner commits to that rule — otherwise keep 'יוצא תוך יום עסקים'. No countdown timers.

findings.principle: Why checkouts are abandoned (extra costs, slow delivery, trust, returns)
findings.what: Baymard's aggregate: 70.22% average documented cart-abandonment rate across 50 studies. Reasons for abandonment during checkout (excluding 'just browsing'): 40% extra costs too high; 20% delivery too slow; 19% didn't trust the site with credit-card information; 18% forced account creation; 17% too long/complicated checkout; 13% returns policy unsatisfactory; 12% couldn't see total cost upfront; 9% insufficient payment methods.
findings.source: Baymard Institute — https://baymard.com/lists/cart-abandonment-rate
findings.honestApplication: mikra already shows ₪29 shipping and the free-≥₪550 threshold on the PDP assurance line, cart and checkout, and has guest checkout — the top two causes are handled. For the 19% trust item: once Grow is live (paymentReady in lib/grow.ts), show the real payment marks (cards, Bit, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal) beside the checkout button and in CartDrawer.tsx — real logos of enabled methods only, no generic 'secure' seals. For the 13% returns item: the returns line ('החזרה תוך 30 יום') is on the PDP but absent from checkout — add it under the pay button in CheckoutForm.tsx.

findings.principle: Gifting-flow UX: designate as gift, show gift options on the PDP, relabel recipient fields, allow a message
findings.what: Baymard benchmark: 46% of sites don't let users place a gift order (some abandoned outright); 80% don't show gifting options on product pages, although users research gift compatibility early; 42% lack cart-level gift designation; no benchmarked site dynamically relabels shipping fields as 'Recipient's address' (users accidentally ship gifts to themselves). In a checkout test, 53% of users sending a gift also added a personal gift message.
findings.source: Baymard Institute — https://baymard.com/blog/gifting-flow
findings.honestApplication: mikra is unusually good here: the gift-box toggle sits on the PDP (ProductView.tsx) and checkout has 'זו מתנה — לשלוח היישר לנמען' with separate recipient fields and autoComplete='off' (lib/checkout.ts). Three honest additions: (1) a gift-message field (see Zhang/Epley finding) — the 53% figure says half of gift senders will use it; (2) a factual 'בלי מחיר בחבילה' line, but only after the owner checks what the WooCommerce packing slip prints; (3) show the gift-box toggle's real cost and a real photo. Nothing here needs a review or a number the store doesn't have.

findings.principle: Gift wrapping improves attitude via mood; neatness raises expectations for close relationships
findings.what: Howard (1992), four experiments: gift wrapping favourably influenced attitudes toward the item received, mediated by the happy mood that wrapping cues. Rixom, Mas & Rixom (2020): when the giver is a friend, recipients liked neatly wrapped gifts less than sloppily wrapped ones because neat wrapping raised expectations (contrast effect); when the giver is an acquaintance, neat wrapping improved liking (assimilation).
findings.source: Daniel J. Howard, J. Consumer Psychology 1(3) — https://myscp.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1016/S1057-7408(08)80036-8 ; Jessica Rixom, Erick Mas, Brett Rixom, J. Consumer Psychology 30(2) — https://myscp.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/jcpy.1140
findings.honestApplication: Keep the included padded box as the default (lib/extras.ts) and describe the ₪49 upgrade factually as it is now ('קופסה קשיחה עטופה בבד, עם סרט וכרטיס חתום'). Do not sell the upgrade as 'makes the gift more loved' — for a mother or spouse the literature says a lavish wrap raises the bar. The honest add is a photo of each option so the giver can match the wrap to the relationship. Danon's practice ('כל התכשיטים נארזים באריזות מתנה יוקרתיות') shows the category expects the box to be included, which mikra already does.

findings.principle: Personalisation premium: givers value the effort they invest; recipients appreciate customised gifts, but only if the effort is communicated
findings.what: Moreau, Bonney & Herd (2011), two studies on live customisation sites: gift-givers placed a higher value on their own time and effort and reported higher willingness to pay than self-designers; design support was less effective for gifts (it raised expectations without raising evaluations). Franke, Schreier & Kaiser (2010) 'I designed it myself' effect: self-designed products earn a WTP increment beyond preference fit, via feelings of accomplishment. Pizzetti et al. (2024), 4 studies (n=74 and n=134 in studies 1–2): recipients of personalised gifts changed fewer items of the gift and showed higher appreciation and self-esteem, 'regardless of the time and effort the giver put into the process' — but 'you also need to communicate that effort to your recipient'.
findings.source: Moreau/Bonney/Herd, Journal of Marketing 75(5) — https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1509/jmkg.75.5.120 ; Franke/Schreier/Kaiser, Management Science 56(1) — https://econpapers.repec.org/RePEc:inm:ormnsc:v:56:y:2010:i:1:p:125-140 ; Pizzetti et al., Psychology & Marketing — https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/mar.22034 (Univ. of Bath summary: https://www.bath.ac.uk/announcements/personalised-gifts-create-lasting-emotional-connections-and-enhance-self-esteem-new-research/)
findings.honestApplication: The blessing choice is mikra's real customisation — engraved per order, chosen from a read-before-you-buy list. Make that effort legible to the recipient: the card already names the blessing; add the giver's message line and, on the card, the phrase 'הנוסח נבחר עבורך' (true for 10 of 15 models with more than one blessing). On the PDP, keep the chooser visible (it is) and do not add fake 'design studio' theatrics or 'designed by you' badges — per Moreau et al. extra design support for gifts raises expectations without raising evaluations.

findings.principle: Overly specific gifts: givers personalise to stable traits; recipients want versatility
findings.what: Steffel, Williams & LeBoeuf: givers focus on what recipients are like rather than what they would like, choosing personalised but less versatile gifts; this contributes to non-use (e.g. recipients took longer to redeem retailer-specific gift cards than general ones, which givers failed to anticipate). Presented at SPSP 2014; working paper Wharton 2015.
findings.source: Mary Steffel (Northeastern), Elanor Williams, Robyn LeBoeuf — SPSP/ScienceDaily https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2014/12/141222111553.htm ; working paper https://marketing.wharton.upenn.edu/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Steffel-Williams-LeBoeuf-April-2015.pdf
findings.honestApplication: Present 'הברכה שלך' (Deut. 7/28 + Ps. 128) as the versatile default when the giver is unsure — its blurb in lib/blessings.ts already says 'כשלא רוצים למקד לכיוון אחד'. In the chooser, this can be the first card with a factual 'הרחבה ביותר' note, not a 'most popular' claim (there is no sales data to support 'popular'). In guides, stress the jewel's versatility (steel, hides under a shirt, one size) so the gift is worn beyond the occasion.

findings.principle: Category conventions in Israeli and global jewellery stores (observed elements)
findings.what: Pandora IL (pandora-shop.co.il): header gift finder 'המתנה המושלמת' by recipient/occasion — 'מתנות לאמא', 'מתנות ללידה', 'מתנות לבת מצווה', 'מתנות לגבר', 'מתנות לחתונה ויום נישואין', 'מתנות ליום הולדת'; banners 'החזרות והחלפות חינם', 'משלוח מהיום להיום'; returns page: exchange up to 14 days with 'חשבונית/פתק החלפה', 'לא ניתן להחזיר/להחליף תכשיטים עם חריטה אישית', returns coordinated by WhatsApp 050-4842323 with hours א'-ה' 09:00-16:00, courier return ₪30. Danon (danon-jewellery.co.il): free shipping over ₪299, home delivery 'עד 3 ימי עסקים', '30 ימים של החלפות והחזרות', 'פתק החלפה מצורף לכל הזמנה', gift intent via order comments, installments tiered (2 payments from ₪299 up to 5 from ₪899), 1-year warranty. Shani Jacobi: banner '★ שליח עד הבית חינם - בקניה מעל 299 ש"ח ★', 'עד 12 חודשי אחריות על תכשיטים נבחרים', WhatsApp 050-4439344 with hours א'-ה' 09:00-17:00, 'מתנות לאישה' category, gift cards. Mejuri PDP (vermeil-linked-necklace): beside the $238 price and 4.5 rating — 'In Stock & Available to Ship', '2 Year Warranty', 'Free Returns & Exchanges', 'Free Shipping', Size Guide; gift notes 'printed exactly how it is entered'; gift recipients get store credit; 'Engraved and monogrammed products' non-returnable. Etsy: 'Mark order as a gift' hides the price on the packing slip, 150-character gift message, optional gift-teaser email to the recipient with message, item preview and tracking, schedulable to a date (Aug 2024 update).
findings.source: https://www.pandora-shop.co.il/ and https://www.pandora-shop.co.il/%d7%94%d7%97%d7%96%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%94%d7%97%d7%9c%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%aa/ ; https://danon-jewellery.co.il/pages/shipping-information and https://danon-jewellery.co.il/pages/danonfaq ; https://www.shanijacobi.co.il/ ; https://mejuri.com/shop/products/vermeil-linked-necklace , https://mejuri.com/faq/gifting , https://mejuri.com/faq/return-exchanges ; Etsy Help https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/20646657966231-How-to-Buy-a-Gift-on-Etsy and https://www.valueaddedresource.net/etsy-gift-teaser-august-2024-update/
findings.honestApplication: Four honest borrowings: (1) recipient-first navigation — mikra's 8 gift guides (lib/guides.data.ts: לאמא, לגיוס, למילואימניק, לטיול, לפתיחת עסק, לגבר…) are linked only from the footer (components/Footer.tsx line 91); add a 'מתנה ל…' entry in the header and a guide strip on the homepage, mirroring Pandora IL's 'המתנה המושלמת'. (2) WhatsApp hours next to the number — lib/company.ts has the number but no hours; every Israeli competitor shows them. (3) A price-less exchange slip in the box, as Danon and Pandora IL do. (4) The differentiator none of them can claim: engraved items are non-returnable at Pandora IL and Mejuri, while mikra's closed-list engraving keeps the full cancellation right — say it in one line beside the chooser. Etsy's gift-teaser is honest and useful for late gifts, but needs outbound email, which the store does not have yet (CLAUDE.md: 'אין דוא"ל יוצא') — a WhatsApp-forwardable order card is the feasible version today.

findings.principle: Thematic 'gift finder' browsing helps non-expert shoppers
findings.what: Baymard's mobile search & navigation benchmark: thematic browsing (by occasion, personality, recipient — e.g. a 'gift finder') was observed to be a powerful tool for users who are not product-domain experts, yet 34% of mobile sites had no thematic browsing feature; gift shoppers must otherwise assess each site for gifting options.
findings.source: Baymard Institute — https://baymard.com/blog/mobile-ecommerce-search-and-navigation (and https://baymard.com/blog/gifting-flow)
findings.honestApplication: The blessing data already carries `forWhom` and `gift` occasion strings (lib/blessings.ts: 'גיוס · נסיעה · טיול אחרי צבא', 'לידה · ברית · יום הולדת ראשון', 'פתיחת עסק · תפקיד חדש'…), and the guides exist. Build the recipient/occasion entry from that data: a homepage row 'למי המתנה?' with the five blessing cards labelled by `forWhom`, each linking to the matching guide and pre-filtering the catalogue. This is navigation, not persuasion — no invented 'bestseller' or 'most gifted' labels (the Bestsellers component naming should not imply sales data the store does not have).

findings.principle: Installments (תשלומים) as the default Israeli price frame
findings.what: Interest-free card installments are a cultural default in Israel, not a financing add-on. Bank Leumi's VP strategy, quoted by ynetnews (17 May 2026): "In many ways, Israel is already at the next stage of what the world is now calling 'buy now, pay later'"; the article says typical plans run 3-4 up to 10-12 installments. A practitioner guide for selling in Israel states that showing installments on the product page ("ILS 399 or 3 payments of ILS 133") is standard and that not offering tashlumim at checkout is like not accepting the most common payment method. Grow (the terminal about to be connected) supports up to 12 installments per Wix's Grow help page. The direct competitor TANAOR shows in its buy box "או עד 8 תשלומים שווים של 70 ₪" (live page, Sep 2026). Cards were 71% of Israeli online purchases in 2023 (PPRO via Statista).
findings.source: ynetnews https://www.ynetnews.com/business/article/h1bi8tmh11g ; easyappsecom Israel guide https://easyappsecom.com/guides/selling-on-shopify-israel ; Wix on Grow https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-grow-by-meshulam-as-a-payment-provider ; TANAOR product page https://tanaorjewelry.co.il/products/copy-of-tanaor-pendant ; Statista/PPRO https://www.statista.com/statistics/1270324/israel-online-payment-methods-breakdown-by-type/
findings.honestApplication: Already done in principle: ProductView.tsx and CartDrawer.tsx render "או עד 5 תשלומים של כ־₪X" and the ticker says "עד 5 תשלומים ללא ריבית". Two honest fixes: (1) the number lives in two places - INSTALLMENTS=5 in lib/extras.ts and POLICY.maxInstallments=5 in lib/policy.ts - collapse to one, and set it to exactly what the Grow terminal is configured for the day it goes live (Grow allows up to 12; 5 is a business choice, not a technical one). (2) Only keep "ללא ריבית" if the Grow plan is regular merchant-funded installments and not a "קרדיט" plan; verify on the live Grow page. The per-installment figure is real arithmetic (₪749/5 = ₪150), so it can stay next to every price.

findings.principle: Cards first; wallets and Bit are secondary online (payment-mix familiarity)
findings.what: Bank of Israel's payment-system review (Aug 2024, Shva data for July 2023): 65.8% of in-store card spending was contactless/wallet/smartwatch, and digital wallets reached ₪3.586bn in a month = 8.71% of card spending. Shva via Calcalist (1 Apr 2024): wallets were 27.8% of physical card transactions in Feb 2024 but 11.9% of all card transactions; Shva via Maariv (22 Dec 2024): wallets 35.9% of in-store purchases, and verbatim "חלקם של הארנקים ברכישות אונליין נשאר קטן". PPRO 2023: cards 71% of Israeli online purchases, e-wallets over a quarter. Bit has ~3 million users (Globes, 14 Nov 2024). Israel Internet Association 2022 diary survey: 95% use credit cards, 76% use payment apps in general - but about half of the Arab and Haredi populations do not use payment apps at all ("מחצית מהאוכלוסיה הערבית והחרדית לא נוהגים להשתמש ביישומון להעברת תשלומים"). Apple Pay's own launch effect was a 1,200% jump in wallet transactions (Shva via ynet, June 2021) - in stores.
findings.source: Bank of Israel review PDF https://www.boi.org.il/media/bjejtt5e/סקירת-מערך-התשלומים-בישראל.pdf ; Calcalist https://www.calcalist.co.il/investing/article/hyinqgdyr ; Maariv https://www.maariv.co.il/economy/israel/article-1158095 ; Globes https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-hapoalim-reveals-bit-app-charges-from-january-1001494038 ; ISOC survey https://www.isoc.org.il/sts-data/payment-methods-survey ; ynet Apple Pay https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/hkska8tau
findings.honestApplication: Keep the PaymentMarks order as it is (Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Isracard/Diners first, then Bit/Apple/Google/PayPal) and keep the lib/payments.ts rule that a mark appears only when it is live in Grow. Do not build the checkout around an Apple Pay express button - online, the card + installments path is what Israelis actually use. Because a blessing-jewellery audience skews religious and that segment uses payment apps far less, the manual fallback (order captured, payment link by WhatsApp/phone) should remain a first-class path even after Grow is live, and the phone number should stay visible next to the pay button. Consider a Bit-specific Grow page only if the terminal data later shows Bit demand.

findings.principle: Statutory cancellation right is the floor; jewellery is not an exception; 30 days beats both the law and the competitor
findings.what: Consumer Protection Law s.14ג(ג): a distance sale may be cancelled within 14 days of receiving the product or the disclosure document, whichever is later. The exceptions in s.14ג(ד) are perishables, hospitality/travel within 7 days, information, "טובין שיוצרו במיוחד בעבור הצרכן בעקבות העסקה", and opened recordable media - jewellery is not listed. s.14ה: refund within 14 days of the notice, cancellation fee capped at "5% ממחיר הנכס ... או 100 שקלים חדשים, לפי הנמוך מביניהם". Even the in-store Cancellation Regulations (2010) allow returning "תכשיט שהמחיר ששולם בעדו אינו עולה על 3,000 שקלים חדשים" (schedule item 22) and exclude only jewellery above ₪3,000 (reg. 6(a)(11)) - mikra's whole range (₪279-₪749) is under it. Consumer Council 2022 report: "ביטול עסקה" was the most-searched term on its site; distance-sale complaints rose to 13,785 (+24% vs 2019); merchants charging 25-35% under a "ייצור מיוחד" claim are called out as an improper practice. Competitor TANAOR offers 14 days; Tal Man offers 30-day exchange.
findings.source: Law text https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/חוק_הגנת_הצרכן ; Regulations https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/תקנות_הגנת_הצרכן_(ביטול_עסקה) ; Kol Zchut https://www.kolzchut.org.il/he/ביטול_עסקה_שנעשתה_באינטרנט_או_בטלפון ; Consumer Council 2022 report https://www.consumers.org.il/files/files/2022_report.pdf ; TANAOR https://tanaorjewelry.co.il/ ; Tal Man https://talman.co.il/
findings.honestApplication: The 30-day window in lib/policy.ts is a real differentiator that the site under-sells: on the PDP assurance line and in the cart, phrase it against the legal floor - "החזרה תוך 30 יום (החוק מחייב 14)" - every word derivable. The existing FAQ line "אין חריטה אישית → לא מוצר שיוצר במיוחד → זכות הביטול נשמרת במלואה" is exactly the argument the Council's report validates; keep it and move it up near the blessing selector where the hesitation happens. The header comment in lib/legal.ts can be updated: the ₪3,000 jewellery threshold lives in the in-store regulations and every mikra item is below it, so the lenient position is not merely lenient, it matches both regimes (still a draft for the lawyer). One optional real lever for a gift buyer: waive the 5%/₪100 fee voluntarily and say "בלי דמי ביטול" - only if the owner decides to actually waive it.

findings.principle: Dedicated homepage cancellation link (s.14ט) - a legal duty the live site does not meet
findings.what: s.14ט(ב): "לעניין עסקה שניתן להתקשר לגביה עם צרכן באינטרנט, ייצור עוסק בדף הראשי של אתר האינטרנט שלו קישור ייעודי שבאמצעותו ניתן לשלוח הודעת ביטול". s.14ט(א) lists the channels a business must accept: oral (phone/in store), registered mail, email, fax, and the website. Kol Zchut tells consumers: "בדף הראשי של האתר אמור להופיע קישור שבאמצעותו אפשר לשלוח הודעת ביטול"; the Public Trust organisation's online-shopping checklist tells shoppers to look for a dedicated cancellation link on the homepage. A curl of https://mikra.shop on 15 Sep 2026 shows footer links to /legal/terms, /legal/privacy, /legal/accessibility and /legal/shipping-returns, but no cancellation link; the terms say cancellation is by WhatsApp or email.
findings.source: Law text https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/חוק_הגנת_הצרכן ; Kol Zchut https://www.kolzchut.org.il/he/ביטול_עסקה_שנעשתה_באינטרנט_או_בטלפון ; Emun checklist https://www.emun.org/online-shopping-checklist/
findings.honestApplication: Add a footer link literally labelled "ביטול עסקה" (components/Footer.tsx) to a new /legal/cancel page (lib/legal.ts already drives the legal pages) with a three-field form - name, order number, phone - posting to an API route that emails mikrajewelry@gmail.com and shows an on-screen confirmation with the date the notice was received (the law counts from the notice, which the terms already say). Also list on that page the other accepted channels with the real phone, email and address from lib/company.ts. This is both compliance and a trust signal for a hesitant gift buyer: the escape hatch is one click from every page. Nothing here needs a number that is not already in COMPANY/POLICY.

findings.principle: Verifiable business identity as the substitute for social proof (עוסק מורשה, address, phone)
findings.what: s.14ג(א)(1) requires disclosing in distance marketing "השם, מספר הזהות והכתובת של העוסק בארץ ובחוץ לארץ". The Public Trust checklist tells consumers to verify "שם העסק ומספר הזיהוי שלו (ח.פ או ע.מ)", the address and contact details before buying. Wolt's 2025 Online Consumer Report (JPost, 1 Jan 2026): 72% of Israelis checked reviews before every purchase and 40% ordered more from local businesses since 7 Oct. On the live site the registration number appears only inside /legal/terms; the footer shows phone, WhatsApp, email and the Modi'in address but not the number. Of the Israeli jewellery sites checked (Tal Man, Goldy, TANAOR), all show a phone and address on the homepage and none shows a registration number there.
findings.source: Law text https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/חוק_הגנת_הצרכן ; Emun checklist https://www.emun.org/online-shopping-checklist/ ; JPost/Wolt report https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-881958 ; Tal Man https://talman.co.il/ ; Goldy https://goldytlv.com/
findings.honestApplication: Print COMPANY.regNumber ("עוסק מורשה 2155396360") under the address in the footer contact block - one line, zero new facts. Since reviews cannot be invented, the honest replacements for the 72% who look for them are: a real Google Business Profile at the Modi'in address (link it only once it has genuine reviews; ask real customers by WhatsApp after delivery), the readable full text of every blessing on site, and the local-business framing "עסק ישראלי ממודיעין" which is simply true. One caution before scaling ads: CLAUDE.md's open item says the on-site text is longer than the engraved file for 4 of 5 blessings - the "מילה במילה" promise in Assurance.tsx is itself the store's main proof claim and must be true before it is leaned on.

findings.principle: Delivery is the number-one distance-sale complaint; a stated date is a legal commitment and a conversion asset
findings.what: Consumer Council 2022 complaints report: 65,823 inquiries in the year; distance-sale complaints 13,785 vs 11,085 in 2019 (+24%) while in-store complaints fell 6%; complaints against postal and international courier companies rose 184% vs 2019; verbatim "תלונות רבות עוסקות בזמני המשלוחים מעבר לשעות שנקבעו" and "החוק מחייב את כל השולחים לדייק בזמני הגעת המשלוח, או לשאת בקנס קבוע". Globes (17 Nov 2020): ~20,000 online-shopping complaints by end of October 2020, +130% YoY, with "עיכובים בלתי סבירים ואי אספקה של משלוחים" a recurring theme. s.14ג(א)(4) obliges the seller to disclose "מועד ודרך הספקת הנכס"; s.31א sets ₪10,000 exemplary damages for listed distance-sale breaches (the wikisource extract lists failing to refund within 14 days, over-charging cancellation fees, and non-delivery by the agreed date - lawyer to confirm the last). Verifone survey of ~1,000 Israeli consumers (Walla, 27 Feb 2023): 57% abandoned a purchase in the past year over high shipping costs. Israeli couriers coordinate by phone and SMS (Ratz Plus: "תזכורת S.M.S ללקוח עם יציאת המשלוח לכיוונו", delivery window set by phone).
findings.source: Consumer Council 2022 https://www.consumers.org.il/files/files/2022_report.pdf ; Globes https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001349825 ; Law text https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/חוק_הגנת_הצרכן ; Walla/Verifone https://finance.walla.co.il/item/3561755 ; Ratz Plus https://www.ratz.co.il/ecommerce/
findings.honestApplication: components/DeliveryEstimate.tsx already turns "2-4 ימי עסקים" into calendar dates in the buy box - keep it, and put the same computed date range into the order confirmation and the manual-payment WhatsApp message, because once stated it is binding and it is the thing complainants cite. Add "₪29 · חינם מעל ₪550" to the PDP ASSURANCE line in ProductView.tsx (the price of shipping is currently absent from the PDP and homepage, present only in the cart and FAQ). State a dispatch cutoff ("הזמנה עד השעה X יוצאת היום") only after the owner commits to one. Do not write "SMS מעקב" until the chosen courier is confirmed to send one. If a parcel will be late, message the customer before the promised date - the Council's data says silence is what turns delay into a complaint.

findings.principle: Free-shipping threshold in the announcement bar - the Israeli D2C convention
findings.what: Observed on live Israeli jewellery stores (Sep 2026): Tal Man "משלוח חינם ברכישה מעל 300 ש״ח"; Goldy "משלוח חינם בקנייה מעל ₪500"; Aviv Jewelry free delivery over ₪399 (search snippet); TANAOR "משלוח חינם עד הבית!" (5-8 business days, express ₪39). Verifone 2023 (~1,000 Israelis): shipping cost is the top abandonment trigger at 57%. On mikra.shop the ₪550 threshold from lib/policy.ts appears nowhere on the homepage or PDP HTML (0 hits for "משלוח חינם"); it exists only as the cart progress bar.
findings.source: Tal Man https://talman.co.il/ ; Goldy https://goldytlv.com/ ; TANAOR https://tanaorjewelry.co.il/ ; Walla/Verifone https://finance.walla.co.il/item/3561755
findings.honestApplication: Add "משלוח חינם מעל ₪550" to the PromoBar ticker and to the PDP assurance line, sourced from POLICY.freeShippingOver so it disappears automatically if the policy is switched off (the file's own history shows why). The threshold was chosen as "any two items" (two cheapest = ₪558), so the PairedWith block on the PDP can honestly say "יחד ₪558 - המשלוח חינם" when the pair actually crosses it - computed from lib/catalog.ts prices, never typed. In the cart, freeShippingGap already drives the "עוד ₪X" line; keep it.

findings.principle: WhatsApp as the pre-purchase question channel, with a response-time expectation
findings.what: Statista (Jan 2024): WhatsApp is used by 98% of women and 97% of men in Israel and is the platform with the highest daily use. A Zendesk/Calcalist survey (29 Nov 2021, n=130 - small): 82% want to reach a service rep before buying; preferred channel phone 50%, WhatsApp 18%, email 16%; 86% expect a WhatsApp reply within one hour. Verifone 2023 (~1,000): 22% abandoned a purchase because they could not contact the seller. Bank of Israel notes payment apps are also used P2B. Competitor TANAOR lists "וואטסאפ (הודעות בלבד): 0502989800" and no phone.
findings.source: Statista https://www.statista.com/statistics/1622109/penetration-rate-whatsapp-users-in-israel-by-gender-group/ ; Calcalist/Zendesk https://www.calcalist.co.il/article/skkbllzyy ; Walla/Verifone https://finance.walla.co.il/item/3561755 ; TANAOR https://tanaorjewelry.co.il/
findings.honestApplication: The floating button (WhatsAppFab.tsx) and footer link exist. Three honest upgrades: (1) a contextual "שאלה לפני שקונים? כתבו לנו בוואטסאפ" link under the buy button in ProductView.tsx using wa.me/?text= prefilled with the product name and the selected blessing, so the reply can be specific; (2) publish real answering hours next to it only once the owner commits to them (the 86%-within-an-hour expectation is small-sample, but the manual checkout already promises a payment link "תוך שעה", and CLAUDE.md records that no new-order notification exists - fix the notification before promising any response time); (3) the FAQ is the WhatsApp deflector, and the live page /products/lo-yanum renders "איך בוחרים בין 1 הנוסחים?" - lib/faq.ts needs a singular case for products with one blessing.

findings.principle: Pickup (איסוף עצמי) is a mainstream Israeli preference, not a footnote
findings.what: Verifone survey of ~1,000 Israeli consumers (Walla, 27 Feb 2023): 49% prefer "קנה באונליין - אסוף את המוצר בחנות", 39% online purchase with a pickup point, 39% online purchase with in-store returns. lib/policy.ts already describes pickup as "the only moment a customer holds the jewel before paying for shipping", but on the live site pickup is mentioned only in the FAQ accordion and the checkout radio; the homepage has 0 hits for "איסוף".
findings.source: Walla/Verifone https://finance.walla.co.il/item/3561755
findings.honestApplication: Surface "או איסוף עצמי ממודיעין, בלי עלות" in the PDP assurance line and in the shipping-returns page header, both from SHIPPING in lib/policy.ts. In Meta/Google targeting, a Modi'in-radius audience can be shown the pickup line specifically. The WhatsApp coordination link that CheckoutForm.tsx already shows when pickup is selected is the right pattern; keep it. Nothing else to promise - there is no shop floor, so do not imply walk-in hours.

findings.principle: Mobile and desktop are near-even in Israel; phone number is the courier's key, so phone-first forms and LTR digits matter
findings.what: Statcounter, Israel, August 2026: desktop 49.79%, mobile 48.76%, tablet 1.45% - an almost even split, unlike mobile-dominant markets. Stripe's Israel guide: 40% of e-commerce transactions are made on a mobile device. Israeli couriers coordinate delivery by phone and SMS to the recipient (Ratz Plus e-commerce page). DataReportal Jan 2025: 8.61m internet users, 91.1% penetration.
findings.source: Statcounter https://gs.statcounter.com/platform-market-share/desktop-mobile-tablet/israel ; Stripe https://stripe.com/resources/more/payments-in-israel ; Ratz Plus https://www.ratz.co.il/ecommerce/ ; DataReportal https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2025-israel
findings.honestApplication: Do not treat the site as mobile-only: the known open issue (buy button at 1,176px on mobile vs 790 at TANAOR) matters, but the desktop sticky buy box in ProductView.tsx (lg:sticky) deserves the same care, since roughly half of Israeli traffic is desktop. In lib/checkout.ts FIELDS, move phone above email (the courier and the WhatsApp payment link both key on the phone; email is for the receipt) and add inputMode="tel" / "numeric" to phone and postcode inputs in CheckoutForm.tsx; keep the recipient-phone-required rule and the .ltr/.num wrapping of digits that the code already uses. These are UX conventions, not claims - no copy changes needed.

findings.principle: Gift flow conventions: ship to the recipient, invoice stays with the buyer, packaging price stated
findings.what: Israeli competitors price the gift box separately and say so on the product page (TANAOR: "אריזת מתנה" ₪70 / ₪35; Tal Man: "כל פריט מגיע באריזת מתנה יוקרתית"). mikra's checkout already has "זו מתנה — לשלוח היישר לנמען · החבילה תגיע לכתובת שלו, והחשבונית נשארת על שמך" and validates the recipient's phone because the courier calls the recipient; the PDP mentions the padded box and the blessing card and the ₪49 gift box in the FAQ only.
findings.source: TANAOR https://tanaorjewelry.co.il/products/copy-of-tanaor-pendant ; Tal Man https://talman.co.il/ ; mikra source app/checkout/CheckoutForm.tsx and lib/checkout.ts
findings.honestApplication: Because the buyer is usually not the wearer, say on the PDP - above the fold, not in the accordion - the three things that are already true: "אפשר לשלוח ישירות למקבל/ת המתנה", "קופסה מרופדת וכרטיס הנוסח כלולים", "אריזת מתנה ₪49" (GIFT_BOX from lib/extras.ts). Add the toRecipient option as a hint in the cart drawer so the gift buyer knows before checkout that the recipient's address is accepted. No new numbers, no new promises.

findings.principle: Continuity into the hosted payment page (Grow) - pre-announce the redirect and the fields
findings.what: Grow's developer docs describe a generic hosted payment page plus method-specific pages (credit card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Bit, Bit QR) and allow "up to 2 additional fields from existing options, such as Full Name, Phone, Email, Name for invoice, ID number, City, Street & house number". Wix's Grow page: customers can pay in up to 12 installments. Bank of Israel describes online card payments as "עסקה במסמך חסר" (no physical card, no PIN), the category where the customer has the strongest right to dispute; Tranzila notes CVV2 has been mandatory for such transactions since 2009. The mikra checkout already says card details go straight to the acquirer and are not stored.
findings.source: Grow developers https://developers.grow.business/reference/payment-page ; Wix https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-grow-by-meshulam-as-a-payment-provider ; Bank of Israel review https://www.boi.org.il/media/bjejtt5e/סקירת-מערך-התשלומים-בישראל.pdf ; Tranzila CVV2 https://www.tranzila.com/cvv2.html
findings.honestApplication: Once GROW_USER_ID/GROW_PAGE_CODE are set, open the live Grow page and record exactly which fields it asks for (card, expiry, CVV, and whether ID number is enabled) and the installment selector's maximum; then in CheckoutForm.tsx, above the pay button, write one sentence that matches it: "לתשלום תועברו לעמוד המאובטח של Grow; יתבקשו פרטי כרטיס ו-CVV [ות.ז. אם מוגדר], ואפשר לבחור עד 5 תשלומים". Pass the same total the summary shows so the shopper never sees a different number on the Grow page (the server already recomputes totals from the catalog). Prefer the generic Grow page over method-specific pages so Bit/Apple Pay appear as options rather than as separate flows.

findings.principle: Reviews are expected but cannot be faked - redirect the proof to things a buyer can verify themselves
findings.what: Wolt 2025 Online Consumer Report (JPost, 1 Jan 2026): 78% of Israelis shopped online in 2025, 61% at least monthly; 72% checked reviews before every purchase; 56% compared prices on external sites; 40% ordered more from local businesses since 7 Oct. The direct competitor's homepage shows "מעל 4,500+ המלצות 5 כוכבים" and "מעל 100,000+ לקוחות מרוצים" plus rabbinical and Tel Aviv University certificates; that is the field mikra enters with zero reviews.
findings.source: JPost/Wolt https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-881958 ; TANAOR https://tanaorjewelry.co.il/
findings.honestApplication: Not applicable as social proof - the hard rule forbids it and Google penalises rating markup without ratings (already handled in lib/schema.ts). What is honest and Israeli-specific: (1) proof the buyer can check alone - the full blessing text on /blessings compared to the source, the microscope imagery in NanoLoupe/ZoomLadder, the 1-year warranty and 30-day return in writing; (2) a real certificate only if one exists (the competitor's rabbinical/university letters are a category norm; do not imitate without a genuine document); (3) start collecting genuine Google reviews after the first deliveries and show them only via Google's own widget when they exist. Until the OPEN-claims-audit is resolved (site text longer than engraved file), the strongest proof claim on the site is unverified - resolve it before spending on traffic.

friction: Hero headline 'כל הנוסח. לא שורה ממנו.' + 'עד 4,937 תווים נצרבים על שטח של חצי מילימטר רבוע. חמישה נוסחים - אחד שלכם.' never names the object (necklace/bracelet) or the gift use; the word 'מתנה' first appears in the last section 'מה נותנים למי שיש לו הכול?', and the eight gift guides (/guides: 'מתנה לגיוס', 'מתנה לאמא שיש לה הכל'...) are linked only from the footer link 'מדריכי מתנה'.
Primary hero button 'לבחירת הברכה' sends the visitor to /blessings, a reading page with no prices and no buy button; the buying path is the secondary 'לקטלוג'.

Badge 'הדגם המוביל' on תּוֹלְדוֹת ₪749 (lib/catalog.ts `badge: 'הדגם המוביל'`) while Bestsellers.tsx's own comment states the store has no sales data to justify a bestseller label ('לחנות אין עדיין נתוני מכירה שמצדיקים אותה') — a rank claim with no source, against the house rule.
Footer newsletter copy 'דגמים חדשים, סדרות מוגבלות, ומעט מאוד דואר' — 'סדרות מוגבלות' with no limited series anywhere in the 15-item catalogue reads as manufactured scarcity.

Promo bar item '20% הנחה על ההזמנה הראשונה · להצטרפות למועדון' is plain text (PromoBar.tsx renders <span>s, no link). The code MIKRA20 is only handed out by SignupPopup (opens once per visitor after 18s or 35% scroll, asks name+phone+email); the footer form is email-only and app/api/subscribe/route.ts returns no code for source='footer'. A visitor who closed the popup has no route to the discount the bar keeps promising.
Category card renders 'לתינוק 1 דגמים' and '₪749 - ₪749' (Categories.tsx prints `{products.length} דגמים` and `{min} - {max}` unconditionally) — template output on a page that otherwise avoids it.
Process step ד promises 'כל פריט יוצא עם מספר סידורי ותעודה', but no certificate appears in the PDP 'מה מגיע בקופסה' (BOX_SPEC) or in /legal/shipping-returns 'מה מגיע בחבילה'.
Every visual proof of the engraving is a render: 'הדמיית פני השבב · הגדלה פי 9', the stats '1,489 / 0.5 / 9 / 500'; there is no photograph of a real chip under magnification anywhere on the site.
Server HTML carries the mouse instruction 'העבירו את הסמן - הזכוכית המגדלת נפתחת'; NanoLoupe only swaps to 'גררו את האצבע' after hydration, so a phone reader sees desktop copy first.

'תשלום מאובטח' appears once (Closing line 'משלוח 2-4 ימי עסקים · החזרה תוך 30 יום · תשלום מאובטח') and no payment method is named anywhere — grep of all fetched pages finds no Visa/Mastercard/Bit/Apple Pay/PayPal text or logo.

No business hours anywhere on the site (grep for 'שעות הפעילות' finds only the checkout API message), although WhatsApp is the main channel and the API promises a payment link 'תוך שעה בשעות הפעילות'.
strengths: Promo bar is generated from POLICY/GIFT_BOX so it cannot drift: 'עד 5 תשלומים ללא ריבית · החזרה תוך 30 יום · משלוח מבוטח · 2-4 ימי עסקים · קופסה מרופדת וכרטיס ברכה בכל הזמנה · אריזת מתנה ב־₪49 · שנה אחריות על גוף התכשיט'.
Prices are visible one swipe after the hero ('מאיפה מתחילים' cards: ₪299–₪749, material, '3 ברכות לבחירה', chain length) — Bestsellers.tsx comment: an ad visitor sees prices 'תוך שנייה'.
'ככה זה נראה כשעונדים' strip uses real worn photos with descriptive alts (e.g. 'שרשרת לא ינום בכסף על צוואר אישה בחולצה לבנה...').
Hero sources line 'דברים ז׳, י״ב-ט״ו · תהילים צ״א · תהילים כ״ד · משלי ל״א, י׳-ל״א · ברכת כהנים' gives authority without inventing social proof; the Hero comment explicitly refuses fake reviews.

Assurance section is specific and honest: 'שנה על פגמי ייצור בגוף התכשיט - השבב במשבצתו, ההלחמות והחוליות. על הסוגר, שהוא חלק נע, חודשיים. תיקון בתקופה ללא עלות.' and 'אפשר לקרוא אותו כאן באתר לפני שקונים, ולהשוות למקור.'
Real contact details in the footer on every page: tel 050-775-5705, wa.me/972507755705, mikrajewelry@gmail.com, 'גולדה מאיר 112, מודיעין'; WhatsApp FAB fixed on every page.

The 'bestsellers' heading was deliberately changed to 'מאיפה מתחילים' instead of 'הנמכרים ביותר' — no fake counters, no countdown, no 'was' prices (promo.ts AUTO_DISCOUNT=false, list price is the charged price).

friction: Intro claim 'כל תכשיט בקטלוג יכול לשאת כל אחת מהחמש - הבחירה נעשית בעמוד המוצר' is false for the catalogue: lib/catalog.ts limits beseter to ['shmira'], al-kapayim and lo-yanum to ['eshet-chayil'], tzel-knafayim to ['tinok'], luach-libecha to ['shmira']. A buyer who picks a blessing here and then a jewel they like can hit a dead end.

'נענדת על' carriers are 52px image tiles with alt="" and no name or price (BlessingCard.tsx comment: 'בלי מסגרת ובלי מחיר'); on a phone the buyer must tap each tile to learn what it is or what it costs.

No price and no buy CTA on the page — only 'לקריאת הנוסח המלא' per entry; the page order is hero → 360px loupe simulation → five long entries, so the hero's primary CTA lands the buyer two pages away from a price.
Static caption 'העבירו את הסמן - הזכוכית המגדלת נפתחת' under the loupe (mouse wording in SSR HTML).
The gift occasions ('מתאים ל גיוס, נסיעה...') that a gift buyer scans for are only on the detail page, not in this index.
strengths: Each entry answers 'for whom' in plain words ('למי שיוצא לדרך', 'לאם, לאישה, לסבתא', 'לתינוק שנולד'), lists exact sources ('תהילים צ״א · תהילים קכ״א · תפילת הדרך · בראשית ל״ב, ב׳-ג׳ · במדבר ו׳, כ״ב-כ״ז'), shows the opening verse with niqqud and the word count ('341 מילים').
Honest framing of the product's core claim: 'הנוסחים מובאים במלואם, מילה במילה, בלי קיצור ובלי עריכה.'
Clean index layout (Hebrew letter numbering, one rule per entry) with no fake badges, ratings or counters.

friction: Distance to a price: header → '341 מילים · 3,236 תווים · מתאים ל גיוס, נסיעה, טיול אחרי צבא, נהג חדש' → 440px loupe → all 34 numbered verses → only then 'הברכה הזו על' product cards. No early or sticky 'לבחירת תכשיט עם הברכה הזו' control; the only links above the text are the breadcrumb.

Sub-heading 'כל דגם בקטלוג יכול לשאת את שמירה והגנה' is false (8 of 15 models carry it), and the grid renders carriers.slice(0, 6): the two cheapest shmira carriers, חִשּׁוּק ₪279 and לִבִּי עֵר ₪289, are silently omitted with no 'לכל הדגמים' link.

The page says 'מה שכתוב כאן, בניקוד מלא, הוא בדיוק מה שנצרב על השבב', so text glitches read as what will be engraved: verse 34 ends 'יִשְׁעֶךָ.׃' (period followed by sof pasuq), double spaces inside verses ('בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ  יָסֶךְ', 'יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ  אֶלֶף'), and the Divine name is spelled two ways in the same text ('לַיהוָה', 'יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ' in full vs 'לְךָ ה׳' in verse 34; the index page teaser writes 'לַה׳ הָאָרֶץ').
Unanswered for an observant recipient: whether a chip carrying the fully spelled Name may be worn in the shower/toilet/bed; the only related FAQ ('אפשר להתקלח עם זה?') answers water damage, not this.
Typo in the occasions line: 'מתאים ל גיוס' (space after the ל).
Loupe caption 'זהו בדיוק הנוסח שנצרב - העבירו את הסמן כדי לקרוא אותו' is mouse copy.
strengths: 'למי שיוצא לדרך' + 'מתאים ל גיוס, נסיעה, טיול אחרי צבא, נהג חדש' names the exact gift moments a soldier/traveller gift buyer has in mind.
The full text is shown verbatim with verse numbers inside a bordered article: 'בלי קיצור ובלי השמטה' — the buyer can verify before paying.
Product cards under the text carry price, material, '2 ברכות לבחירה' and chain length ('45 ס״מ'), so the jump to a product is informed.
Breadcrumb 'בית / הברכות / שמירה והגנה' and 'ברכות נוספות' list with word counts keep orientation.

friction: Measured live at 375×812: h1 at 692px, price at 826px, 'הוספה לעגלה · ₪299' at 1,251px; the sticky bar is translated off-screen until scrollY > 320, so the first 1.5 screens have no buy control. Page height 10,383px (~13 screens).

No pendant size: specs list only 'אורך השרשרת 45 ס״מ + 5 ס״מ שרשרת הארכה', 'סוגר', 'גימור', while תּוֹלְדוֹת shows 'קוטר המדליון 29.2 מ״מ' and טִפַּת אוֹר '20 × 6.3 מ״מ'. No weight. A buyer cannot tell if the Magen David is 8mm or 25mm.

No worn photo: gallery views are 'התכשיט', 'בסצנה 1–5', 'הברכה על השבב' — there is no 'על הדגם' view (lib/worn.ts has no beseter entry); scene/beseter-1.jpg and beseter-2.jpg are still-life on a shelf/linen with no body or scale reference, for an item tagged audience 'men' and aimed at soldiers' families.

Shipping price is not near the button: the assurance line reads 'משלוח מבוטח · 2-4 ימי עסקים · שנה אחריות · החזרה תוך 30 יום' (no ₪); ₪29 appears only inside the FAQ 'כמה זמן לוקח המשלוח?', and the ₪550 free-shipping threshold is nowhere on the page.

FAQ template leak for single-blessing items: 'איך בוחרים בין 1 הנוסחים?' (productFaq uses product.blessings.length with no singular case); ProductStory says 'אותו דגם נושא נוסחים אחרים' though beseter carries only shmira.
Return policy contradicts itself on the same page: spec row 'החזרה: 30 יום, ללא תנאי' (CARE_SPEC) vs FAQ 'אחרי המשלוח חלה מדיניות ההחזרה הרגילה: 30 יום, כל עוד הפריט לא נלבש ובאריזתו המקורית'.

Gift box '+₪49 … קופסה קשיחה עטופה בבד, עם סרט וכרטיס חתום' — signed by whom? There is no field on PDP, cart or checkout for the giver's own words; /api/checkout accepts `note` but CheckoutForm never sends one.
The blessing chooser heading 'הברכה שנצרבת על השבב' + 'לכל הנוסחים ←' sits above a single disabled radio card 'שמירה והגנה – למי שיוצא לדרך', implying a choice this item does not offer.
'או עד 5 תשלומים של כ־₪60' omits 'ללא ריבית' (only the promo bar says it) and no payment method/logo appears anywhere on the page.
Material line '₪299 פלדת אל־חלד · כסף' — 'כסף' is the finish colour label (FINISHES) but can be read as the metal; silver items read 'כסף 925 · כסף'.
Proof box claims 'עם ניקוד … זה מה שנראה מתחת למיקרוסקופ' but the only visual is 'הדמיית פני השבב' (a render); the home/craft promise 'מספר סידורי ותעודה' is absent from 'מה מגיע בקופסה'.
strengths: Price and instalments directly under the title ('₪299', 'או עד 5 תשלומים של כ־₪60'); the button carries the total 'הוספה לעגלה · ₪299'.
DeliveryEstimate renders a real date window after hydration — live: 'מגיע אליכם 17-21 בספטמבר' (business days, skipping Fri/Sat) — answering 'will it arrive before the event?'.
Blessing card shows the opening verse 'יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן, בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן', 'תהילים צ״א, א׳', '341 מילים' and 'לקריאת הנוסח המלא ←'.

Objection box right after the button, 'איך אפשר לדעת שהנוסח באמת שם?': 'קראו אותו לפני שאתם קונים', 'המקור נקוב בשם. Westminster Leningrad Codex, נחלת הכלל', 'עם ניקוד' — with links 'לקריאת הנוסח המלא ←' and 'איך זה נצרב ←'.
Gift upgrade is transparent: toggle 'אריזת מתנה +₪49' with 'מגיעה סגורה ומוכנה למסירה', while BOX_SPEC states 'קופסה מרופדת - כלולה'.
Sticky bar 'בְּסֵתֶר · שמירה והגנה · ₪299 · הוספה לעגלה' after scrolling; on multi-blessing items it refuses to add without a conscious choice ('בחירת הנוסח').

Nine FAQ answers built on objections and honest: 'אפשר לצרוב נוסח משלי? לא…' (with the cancellation-right upside), 'ומה אם התכשיט נשבר?' (clasp caveat, repair quote before work), 'אפשר להחליף את הברכה אחרי שהזמנתי?' (yes until shipped).
Finish swatches link to the gold sibling with price in the title; full spec accordion includes SKU 'OYANN003S' and 'הברכה שנבחרה'.

steps.page: Cart drawer (opens on add-to-cart) — components/CartDrawer.tsx, lib/cart.ts
friction: Shipping is listed but not summed: live drawer shows 'משלוח ₪29' then 'סה״כ ביניים ₪299' and 'או עד 5 תשלומים של כ־₪60' (CartDrawer.tsx: total = subtotal + giftFee); the next screen's button reads 'לתשלום · ₪328' — a ₪29 jump right before payment.
'עוד ₪251 למשלוח חינם' with fillers 'לוּחַ לִבֶּךָ ₪279 / חִשּׁוּק ₪279 — לבחירה': the upsell costs ~10× the ₪29 it saves, and the maths is on screen.
Code field hint 'חברי המועדון מקבלים קוד להזמנה הראשונה' with no link to join; a visitor who dismissed the popup has no way to obtain MIKRA20 from here.
CTA 'מעבר לתשלום מאובטח' leads to a details form, not to payment, and the drawer shows no payment-method cue.
Cart line shows the blessing chip and '₪299 ליחידה' but not the finish — silver and gold are both named 'בְּסֵתֶר'.
Gift toggle repeated with 'מגיעה סגורה ומוכנה למסירה' — still no message/dedication option.
strengths: Each line shows the engraved blessing as a coloured chip ('שמירה והגנה'); the same jewel with a different blessing is a separate line (lineKey).
Free-shipping progress bar with the exact gap; filler items route to the product page rather than adding blindly (comment: cross-sell 'חייב למסור לקונפיגורטור').
Cart and promo code persist across refresh (zustand persist 'ns-cart'); actionable error copy 'הקוד אינו מזוהה. בדקו את הכתיב ונסו שוב.'
Under the CTA: 'קופסה מרופדת וכרטיס ברכה - כלולים בכל הזמנה'.
42px stepper targets, Escape/backdrop close, body scroll lock.

friction: Measured live at 375×812: the order summary 'ההזמנה' sits at y=1,544, below the submit button at y=1,380 — the buyer fills 7 fields and reaches 'לתשלום · ₪328' before seeing what the ₪328 is made of.

The header marquee '20% הנחה על ההזמנה הראשונה · להצטרפות למועדון' keeps scrolling above the checkout form and the footer newsletter 'מכתב הבית' is present — a discount hint and exits at the moment of payment, while there is no code field on this page (must reopen the cart drawer via the header icon).

Instalments vanish at checkout (CheckoutForm imports no INSTALLMENTS; no 'עד 5 תשלומים' line) and no payment method is named; the only security cue is 'הפרטים נשלחים מוצפנים. פרטי האשראי נמסרים ישירות לחברת הסליקה ואינם נשמרים אצלנו.' — the processor (Grow/Meshulam) is not named and the buyer is not told they will be redirected to an external page (`window.location.href = data.payment`).

When paymentReady is false, submitting all details returns 'נשלח אליך קישור מאובטח לתשלום בוואטסאפ, בדרך כלל תוך שעה בשעות הפעילות. הפריט נשמר עבורך עד אז.' — no published hours anywhere, no visible price lock, and the buyer leaves without having paid.
No gift message field for the 'כרטיס חתום'; `note` is accepted by /api/checkout but the form never sends it.

Ship-to-recipient block 'זו מתנה — לשלוח היישר לנמען · החבילה תגיע לכתובת שלו, והחשבונית נשארת על שמך.' does not say whether a price/invoice is inside the parcel or that the courier will phone the recipient (validate() requires toPhone because 'חברת המשלוחים מתקשרת לנמען', which the buyer is never told).

Page is blank until hydration (`if (!ready) return null`; static HTML contains no form). No required-field markers (all inputs required=false), errors only after the first submit; the pickup address 'האיסוף מגולדה מאיר 112, מודיעין, בתיאום מראש' appears only after choosing pickup.
Summary lines are not editable (no qty/remove); the only escape is '← חזרה לחנות' which drops to the home page, not the cart.
strengths: Delivery choice comes first with prices: 'משלוח עד הבית ₪29 · מבוטח · 2-4 ימי עסקים' vs 'איסוף עצמי ממודיעין · חינם · בתיאום מראש בוואטסאפ'; address fields disappear for pickup and a 'לתיאום המועד בוואטסאפ' link appears.

Gift-shipping flow exists and is safe: recipient fields use autoComplete='off' so the browser cannot autofill the buyer's own address into the recipient block; recipient phone is validated to the same standard.
Short form: 7 fields, 'מיקוד (לא חובה)', correct autocomplete tokens (given-name, tel, street-address…), Israeli phone normalisation (+972 accepted), same validate() on client and server.
Button states the exact total 'לתשלום · ₪328'; free shipping computed on list price identically to the server (shippingCost).
Terms checkbox not pre-checked with links to /legal/terms and /legal/privacy; marketing consent separate and optional ('אפשר להסיר בכל עת').
Server recomputes totals from the catalogue and rejects invalid blessings; coupon-reuse error is actionable: 'קוד ההנחה כבר נוצל - הוא תקף להזמנה הראשונה בלבד. אפשר להסיר אותו בעגלה ולהמשיך בלעדיו.'
WhatsApp FAB remains available on the checkout page; SignupPopup is suppressed on /checkout.

friction: Headline 'ההזמנה התקבלה.' never states that payment succeeded or that a confirmation email is on its way; no order-email mention; delivery is only '2-4 ימי עסקים' while the PDP had shown a concrete window ('מגיע אליכם 17-21 בספטמבר').
Steps '1 הנוסח נצרב … 3 יוצא למשלוח: החבילה יוצאת תוך יום עסקים' place per-order clean-room engraving next to next-day dispatch with no explanation — a careful buyer sees a contradiction.
Manual-payment message 'נשלח אליך קישור מאובטח לתשלום בוואטסאפ, בדרך כלל תוך שעה בשעות הפעילות' with hours undefined; the buyer closes the tab unpaid.
Opening the page directly or in a second tab shows only 'מספר ההזמנה שלך: #N' (readOrderDone is session-scoped) — no recap.
For a gift order the only recipient line is 'החבילה נשלחת ישירות אל X, והחשבונית נשארת על שמך' — nothing about what the recipient will see (price, note, card).
'כתוב לנו עם מספר ההזמנה' is masculine singular while the rest of the site addresses the reader in plural.
strengths: Order number box '#N' plus a full recap: item image, blessing chip, 'סכום הפריטים', discount, gift box, shipping method and 'סה״כ' — the buyer can verify the engraved text choice.
'מה קורה עכשיו' in three steps and an explicit change window: 'רוצה לשנות את הנוסח? אפשר כל עוד ההזמנה לא נשלחה — כתוב לנו עם מספר ההזמנה ונחליף.'
WhatsApp and phone buttons ('050-775-5705') right on the page; cart is cleared after purchase (no double order); purchase event fired once.

friction: Voluntary-return cost is undefined: 'אנו מקבלים החזרה מרצון בתוך 30 יום' and 'ההחזר הכספי מבוצע לכרטיס האשראי … בתוך 14 ימים' say nothing about who pays return shipping or whether a cancellation fee is deducted; only the defective case states 'עלות ההחזרה והמשלוח החוזר עלינו במלואה'. Under the Consumer Protection Law the seller may deduct up to '5% מהמחיר ששולם או 100 ₪, לפי הנמוך מביניהם' and 'על הצרכן להחזיר את המוצר לבעל העסק על חשבונו' (https://www.kolzchut.org.il/he/ביטול_עסקה_שנעשתה_באינטרנט_או_בטלפון) — the page leaves the buyer guessing whether that applies here.

Return condition 'המוצר לא נלבש, באריזתו המקורית ובצירוף חשבונית' contradicts the PDP spec 'החזרה: 30 יום, ללא תנאי'; and a gift recipient has no invoice (it stays on the buyer's name), so there is no stated exchange/return path for the person who actually receives the gift.

'מה מגיע בחבילה' says the card carries 'שם הנוסח שנצרב והמקורות שלו' while the PDP says it also carries the full text; the 'מספר סידורי ותעודה' promised on /craft and the home Process section is absent.
No exchange (החלפה) policy, no gift-receipt option, no tracking/notification promise, no cost stated for remote areas.
Reached only from the mobile menu 'משלוחים והחזרות' and the footer — not from the PDP assurance line 'החזרה תוך 30 יום'.
strengths: Plain numbers, no hedging: 'דמי משלוח עד הבית: ₪29. איסוף עצמי ממודיעין ללא עלות.', 'בהזמנה בסך 550 ₪ ומעלה (לפי מחיר המחירון של הפריטים, לפני הנחה) המשלוח עד הבית חינם', 'אריזת המתנה בתוספת 49 ₪ אינה נספרת לצורך סף המשלוח החינם'.
Business days defined ('אינם כוללים שבתות, חגים וערבי חג') and remote areas named ('אילת, רמת הגולן, מצפה רמון ויישובים מעבר לקו הירוק').
Defective-item promise is concrete: 'צלמו ושלחו אלינו בתוך 14 יום. עלות ההחזרה והמשלוח החוזר עלינו במלואה.'

Legal 14-day right stated alongside the voluntary 30 days; return channel named with number and email ('בוואטסאפ למספר 050-775-5705 או בדואר אלקטרוני ל־mikrajewelry@gmail.com'); 'עודכן לאחרונה: אוגוסט 2026'.

friction: All proof is rendered, none photographed: 'הדמיית פני השבב', 'העבירו את הסמן - הזכוכית המגדלת נפתחת'; no micrograph of a real chip, no photo of the 'תעודה', no lab/partner named for the FIB engraving.

Two of the strongest honest promises live only here: 'כל פריט יוצא עם מספר סידורי ותעודה' and 'לשלוח אלינו לליטוש חינם אחת לשנה - אנחנו מחזירים תוך שבוע' — neither appears on the PDP (BOX_SPEC/CARE_SPEC) or the policy page where a buyer decides.
'לא מצאתם תשובה? כתבו לנו - עונים באותו יום.' is plain text (no link) and 'same day' has no hours behind it.
FAQ 'מאיזה נוסח נלקח הטקסט?' answers 'הנוסחים המסורתיים, כפי שהם' without naming the codex the PDP cites ('Westminster Leningrad Codex').
Water claim is phrased differently here ('אטימה הרמטית - הכתב מוגן מזיעה וממגע מים אקראי') than on the PDP ('עמיד למים, לזיעה ולתמרוקים').
strengths: Scale ladder makes the size tangible: 'התכשיט כ־20 מ״מ → המשבצת כ־5 מ״מ → הכתב 0.009 מ״מ', plus '4,937 תווים בנוסח הארוך ביותר', '0.5 מ״מ רבוע', '500 הגדלה'.
'המספרים היבשים' table: 'ליתוגרפיית קרן יונים ממוקדת (FIB)', 'כ־9 מיקרון', '0.5 מ״מ² (700 × 700 מיקרון)', 'חלון מגן ספיר סינתטי, קשיות 9 מוס', 'השוואה תו־אחר־תו לנוסח המקור'.
Warranty explained with what is and isn't covered: 'שחרור השבב ממשבצתו, פתיחת הלחמה או פתיחת חוליה … הסוגר … חודשיים … שבר, עיקום או נזק שנגרמו משימוש אינם באחריות, ואותם נתקן במחיר עלות'.
Care in four lines ('להסיר לפני מקלחת, ים ובריכה - לא בגלל השבב, אלא בגלל המתכת' …) and a verification promise: 'שבב עם ולו סטייה אחת נפסל ואינו יוצא מהמעבדה'.
